whenToUse: Services that store information of long-unused accounts separately.
People sign in to a dormant account.
Remaining points or history must be reported.
whenNotToUse: Services that leave accounts as they are, with no dormancy.
You'd string out long identity checks.
You wouldn't say what was kept.
accessibility: The stored information is read as a list.
The check marks are decorative, so they're aria-hidden.
The result is read with role="status".
